## Story Goal

Deliver **one consolidated Agent Workspace** replacing the placeholder `DashboardView.vue`. This story merges the four source items DASH-001, DASH-002, DASH-003 and DASH-004 into a single implementation plan. **Do not create separate plan files** for the four sub-items.

The workspace must show, for the signed-in agent, on a single route (`/`):

1. **My open tickets** — a widget listing tickets currently assigned to the logged-in agent, with status, priority, customer name, updated-at, and a link to `TicketDetailsView`.
2. **Recent customers** — a widget listing the customers the agent most recently interacted with, each linking to `CustomerProfileView`.
3. **My tasks / follow-ups** — a widget listing tickets that need action (status = `Open` or `Pending`, or escalated to the agent), sorted by priority then oldest first.
4. **Activity summary** — a small metrics strip: count of open tickets assigned to me, count of tickets breaching SLA today (best-effort: escalated or high-priority open > 24h), count of unread ticket messages on my tickets, count of tickets I resolved in the last 7 days.

**Out of scope:** real-time push, notifications bell/popover, calendar integrations, cross-agent leaderboards, admin/manager dashboards, AI summaries. Any missing backend endpoint is added minimally in this story or the widget degrades gracefully with an empty-state message.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current behaviour:** `DashboardView.vue` is a static placeholder with no real data.
- **New behaviour:** The route renders a real workspace pulling live data from ticket / customer / auth stores. Data must be filtered to the **signed-in agent** (never show other agents' work). Managers/admins see the same widgets scoped to themselves — cross-agent views are out of scope for this story.
- **Consolidation rule:** Deliver DASH-001, DASH-002, DASH-003, DASH-004 in this single story. Do not open follow-up story files for them.

## Backend Tasks

If — and only if — the current tickets list endpoint does not already accept `assigneeId` and a status set filter, extend it minimally. Do **not** create a new "dashboard" endpoint or a new module.

### 1 — Extend the tickets list query

File: `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketEndpoints.cs`

- Locate the `MapGet` handler for the tickets list.
- Ensure the query supports:
  - `assigneeId` (Guid, nullable) — filters `Tickets.Where(t => t.AssigneeId == assigneeId)`.
  - `status` (repeated / comma-separated `TicketStatus` values) — filters by inclusion.
  - `updatedSince` (DateTimeOffset, nullable) — `t.UpdatedAt >= updatedSince`, used for "resolved in last 7 days".
- Keep default sort by `UpdatedAt` desc.
- Do **not** break existing callers: every new parameter is **nullable** with existing behaviour when omitted.

File: `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketContracts.cs`

- Reuse existing `TicketListItemDto` (or equivalent). Do **not** add a new DTO.

### 2 — (Optional) Aggregated counts endpoint

Only add this if a single roundtrip is materially cheaper than three list calls; otherwise skip and let the frontend derive counts from list responses.

Create file: `backend/CRM.Api/Dashboard/DashboardEndpoints.cs`

```csharp
// GET /api/dashboard/me/summary  -> DashboardSummaryDto
public sealed record DashboardSummaryDto(
    int OpenAssignedCount,
    int NeedsActionCount,
    int ResolvedLast7DaysCount,
    int SlaAtRiskCount);
```

- Register in `Program.cs` next to existing endpoint groups.
- Authorize with the same policy used by ticket endpoints (`Roles.Agent` or higher).
- Resolve current agent id from `HttpContext.User` (same pattern as ticket assignment endpoints).
- Query `TicketDbContext` directly; do not add a service layer for four counts.

### 3 — Wiring

File: `backend/CRM.Api/Program.cs`

- If task 2 is taken, register `MapDashboardEndpoints()` after ticket endpoints. No DI changes required beyond the existing `TicketDbContext`.

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Types

File: `frontend/CRM.Web/src/types/dashboard.ts` (new)

```ts
export interface DashboardSummary {
  openAssignedCount: number;
  needsActionCount: number;
  resolvedLast7DaysCount: number;
  slaAtRiskCount: number;
}
```

Reuse `Ticket`, `TicketStatus`, `TicketPriority` from `frontend/CRM.Web/src/types/tickets.ts` and `Customer` from `frontend/CRM.Web/src/types/customers.ts`.

### 2 — API client

Create file: `frontend/CRM.Web/src/api/dashboard.ts`

- Use the axios instance from `frontend/CRM.Web/src/api/http.ts` (same pattern as `api/tickets.ts`).
- Export:
  - `fetchMySummary(): Promise<DashboardSummary>` — calls `/api/dashboard/me/summary` **or** derives from three ticket list calls if the summary endpoint was not added.
- Do **not** duplicate ticket/customer list calls; call the existing `api/tickets.ts` and `api/customers.ts` from the store.

### 3 — Store

Create file: `frontend/CRM.Web/src/stores/dashboard.ts`

- Pinia store `useDashboardStore` with:
  - state: `summary: DashboardSummary | null`, `myOpenTickets: Ticket[]`, `myTasks: Ticket[]`, `recentCustomers: Customer[]`, `loading: boolean`, `error: string | null`.
  - action `loadAll()` — calls the tickets store / API in parallel with `Promise.all`, populates all state, sets `loading` around the call.
  - action `refresh()` — same as `loadAll` but does not toggle `loading` (used by "refresh" button).
- Filters "assigned to me" using `useAuthStore().currentUser.id`. **Do not** filter client-side over a full list; pass `assigneeId` to the backend.
- "Recent customers" = distinct customers from the top N (N=20) tickets in `myOpenTickets` and `myTasks`, ordered by most recent ticket `updatedAt`. No new backend call.

### 4 — Widget components

Create files under `frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/dashboard/components/`:

- `MetricsStrip.vue` — four count tiles bound to `summary`. Each tile is a link to a filtered list view (open assigned → tickets list with query, etc.).
- `MyTicketsWidget.vue` — table/list of `myOpenTickets`; columns: title, customer, priority badge, status badge, updatedAt (relative). Row click → `router.push({ name: 'ticket-details', params: { id } })`.
- `MyTasksWidget.vue` — same shape as `MyTicketsWidget` but bound to `myTasks`; empty-state "No tasks pending".
- `RecentCustomersWidget.vue` — list of up to 8 customers with name, company, last-interaction relative time; item click → `router.push({ name: 'customer-profile', params: { id } })`.

Each widget:

- Accepts no props beyond a boolean `loading` and its slice of data; the parent view feeds it from the store.
- Renders skeleton placeholders while `loading`.
- Renders a localized empty-state via `$t('dashboard.empty.*')`.
- Uses **only** existing design tokens from `frontend/CRM.Web/src/assets/main.css`; do not introduce a new UI kit.

### 5 — Compose the workspace

File: `frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/dashboard/views/DashboardView.vue`

- Replace the placeholder body with a grid:
  - Row 1: `<MetricsStrip>` (full width).
  - Row 2: `<MyTicketsWidget>` (2/3) + `<RecentCustomersWidget>` (1/3).
  - Row 3: `<MyTasksWidget>` (full width).
- On `mounted`, call `dashboard.loadAll()`.
- Add a "Refresh" button in the top-right that calls `dashboard.refresh()`.
- Show `store.error` inline (non-blocking banner) if any widget fetch failed.

### 6 — Router

File: `frontend/CRM.Web/src/router/index.ts`

- Keep the existing dashboard route; only confirm `meta.requiresAuth` is set (should already be true). No new routes.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **No signed-in user** — dashboard route already guarded; the store must still throw a clear error if `authStore.currentUser` is null on entry (defensive). Enforced in `stores/dashboard.ts` `loadAll()`.
- **Agent has zero tickets** — every widget renders its empty-state; metrics show `0`, not blanks.
- **Partial backend failure** — one of three parallel calls rejects. `loadAll` catches per-call, populates what succeeded, sets `error` to the localized message; other widgets still render.
- **RTL layout** — Arabic locale flips the grid; verify `MetricsStrip.vue` and widget rows do not hardcode `margin-left`. Use logical properties (`margin-inline-start`) or Flexbox gaps.
- **Very long ticket titles / customer names** — truncate with CSS `text-overflow: ellipsis` and a `title` attribute for hover.
- **Timezone** — relative times use the browser locale; do not format on the backend.
- **Permission drift** — non-agent roles (e.g. read-only viewer) reaching `/` should still see the page but with empty widgets, not a 403 loop. Enforced in the dashboard endpoint / list-filter behaviour.
- **Duplicated customers across widgets** — dedupe by `customer.id` in `recentCustomers` computed slice.
- **Slow network** — `loading` is set immediately; skeletons render within the first paint. `refresh()` does not blank existing data.
- **Backend list endpoint pagination** — request only the first page (page size 25) for each widget; do not fetch all tickets.

7. **Regression:** Manually visit tickets list and a customer profile; confirm no regressions from the extended ticket list filters.
8. **RTL check:** Switch locale to Arabic in `AppShell.vue`; confirm dashboard grid mirrors correctly.
